lines.t: I headed over to Eileen's workplace in time for our meeting.
I think she said it was a clinic called Saverim or something like that...
Near Saverim
Ah!
{player}! Over here, over here!
Hehehe! Hello!!
Is this where you work?
No, it's that clinic right ahead called Saverim! It's a place where they treat injured people!
My job is to keep watch and make sure there are no bad guys! *Ahem!*
Honestly, I worked so hard today that I nodded off a tiny bit...
But {player}, since we're going for a walk together, I pushed through until the end!
Hehe, didn't I do a good job!?
Sure, sure.
Ehehehe!
And we have snacks waiting for us too!
Shall we head over right now!?
I heard it's not far from here!
So, where exactly are we going?
Oh? Didn't I tell you?
It's a newly opened cake shop on 5th Avenue!
Apparently it's already super popular!
I'm so excited, hehe!
I don't have any money.
You're treating me, right?
Hehe! Leave it to me!
I saved up a ton of money just for today!
Let's go!
We are sold out for today!
Hmm.
Th-They're sold out already...?
Why are there so many people!!?
Why are you asking me?
Hmph, I didn't think there would be this many people!
Ugh... What do we do now? Can we not get any snacks...?
We can just come back next time.
But...
No matter how fast I run after work, I feel like I'll always be too late...
Oh?
Eileen?
Huh?
Oh, it's the crepe shop manager!
Someone you know?
She's the manager of the snack shop I go to all the time!
Heh, seeing you here, I guess you were after <bouten>that</bouten> too, Eileen?
This cake shop's grand opening limited-edition special...
The <bouten>Quadruple Chocolat Mousse Strawberry Cream Wave Shortcake No. 7</bouten>!!
Hehe, exactly!! You know me so well, Manager!
Quadruple... what?
It's the <bouten>Quadruple Chocolat Mousse Strawberry Cream Wave Shortcake No. 7</bouten>!
You actually memorized that?
Hehe, I have a great memory when it comes to delicious things!
The <bouten>Quadruple Chocolat Mousse Strawberry Cream Wave Shortcake No. 7</bouten> is super popular on social media these days, isn't it?
The line was so long that even I couldn't get one...
Aww, I really wanted to try it... The <bouten>Quadruple Chocolat Mousse Strawberry Cream Wave Shortcake No. 7</bouten>...
My whole world has collapsed...
I totally get it. A day without snacks is the absolute worst...
(Is it really that serious?)
Heh... Well, I have some news that might cheer Eileen up!
Really??
Oh? Looking at your reaction, you must not know yet.
Heh, here! Take a look at this.
The crepe shop manager handed something over.
This is... Ah!??
{player}!! L-Look at this!!!
World Snack Festival'?
What is this?
If we go here they say we can eat so many snacks!!!!
Who on earth created such a wonderful thing?!?!?
Huh? Oh, well... I'm not really sure about that, but...
Anyway, the important thing is that a grand festival is being held soon!
Actually, our shop is planning to participate too, so I'd love for you two to come and do a taste test!
{player}! We absolutely, positively have to go here!!
The saying that even if the heavens crumble, there will always be a snack, was true...!!
I've never heard that saying in my entire life.
Let's eat to our heart's content here instead of the <bouten>Quadruple Chocolat Mousse Strawberry Cream Wave Shortcake No. 7</bouten> we couldn't buy today!!
Well, if I have time.
Okay! It's a promise, hehe!!
Then let's go eat crepes instead of cake for today's snack!
You're coming to our shop, right?
Ehehe, that's right!!
Then I'll have to prepare a crepe that's way more delicious than the <bouten>Quadruple Chocolat Mousse Strawberry Cream Wave Shortcake No. 7</bouten> just for Eileen!
Wow!!!
Heh! Let's go!

So instead of that Quadruple... whatever, we stopped by the crepe shop manager's place,
bought some crepes, and headed back.

lines.t: I headed to Saverim to meet Eileen at the promised time.
But...
In Front of Saverim
Why is there such a huge crowd here again?
Hurry up and examine me! Isn't this a hospital?!
Ugh... Please wait your turn—
Ugh, shut up! Just bring out the person in charge!
Uuugh...
{player}! Hello, hehehe!
...Gasp! No, this isn't the time for that!
{player}! We have a big problem, a huge problem!!
Right, call me when you're done.
Aww! Don't be like that!
Please help me stop these weird people!!
Who are you calling weird?!
You're the weird one here!
Why are you getting in the way of a patient trying to see a doctor?!
Yeah! Are you going to take responsibility if something goes wrong?!
Hurry up and move! Every second counts here!!
Oh, my goodness! I'm dying here!
So, what is going on here?
Sigh, well...
A moment ago, they showed up and suddenly demanded to be treated...
So when I asked them to take a number and wait, they suddenly started getting angry...
Even though other people were here first, they kept shouting to be seen first...
They even tried to steal other people's numbers by force...
What?! You told us to get a number, so we did!
The service at this hospital is absolutely terrible!
Do we need to file a bunch of complaints for you to wake up?! Huh?!
Uuugh...
{player}, w-what should we do now...?
What do you mean, "what should we do"?
Don't you remember when we bought that cake?
Did we stand in line because we're fools?
Y-You're right! Exactly! That's how it's supposed to be!
Did you hear that?! No matter how much you complain, wrong is wrong!!
If you want to be treated, wait your turn honestly! Stop stealing other people's numbers!!
How dare you treat a patient like this...
Eeeek! I-I can't take it anymore...!!
A-Are you okay?!
Uuurgh! I-I have an emergency too...!!
I-I can't! I'm really going to die!!
Y-Yeah! Can't you see how urgent this is?!
Medicine! Give us the medicine right now!!
...You stubborn, bad people!
If you keep causing trouble, I'll have to—!!
Well, calm down for a second.
Huh??
If it's that urgent, you should at least tell us your symptoms so we can understand.
S-Symptoms? Ugh...!!
J-Just give me any medicine that stops stomach pain quickly...!
M-My stomach... Urgh... M-My stomach hurts...
...Your stomach hurts?
Y-Yes, exactly...
Did I eat something bad, ugh... at the f-festival...?
Huh? The festival?
Don't tell me, the World Snack Festival or whatever it's called?
Y-Yes...
I guess I ate t-too much trying to get my ticket's worth...?
Anyway... we couldn't take it anymore, so we came to the hospital...
Then you should have just said it was an emergency.
I-I'm sorry...
Just save us this once...
Fine! I'll go ask if we can get some medicine for you!
But you must wait in line next time!!
O-Okay, got it...Gym Uniform Girl A
Yes...Gym Uniform Girl B
A moment later
Here! They said this medicine helps when your stomach feels bad!
You have to be good now, okay?!
Y-Yeah... th-thanks!
I won't forget this favor...
The Gym Uniform Girls, holding the medicine, quickly hurried away.
Heh, heh, heh!I successfully protected Saverim again today!
Hehe, {player}, did I do well?!
Sure, sure.
Ehehehe!
...Huh?
Hmm... But I feel like I'm forgetting something...
Didn't you say we were going to the Snack Festival today?
Oh.
Ahhhhh!!!!
Since the timing had become awkward, we decided to postpone our visit to the festival.
